status_tracking.where: Bill Pay payment history/upcoming; account activity page

exceptions.bank_handling: Bill Payment Service Guarantee: if notified immediately (within 60 days of Scheduled Payment Date), TD bears late-payment charges up to $50 when a payment posts after its Scheduled Payment Date; void for insufficient funds, wrong biller info or exception payments.

exceptions.trigger: Customer tries to cancel a bill payment too close to the payment date
exceptions.customer_experience: Bill Pay informs the customer it is too close to the payment date to cancel; stop payments cannot be placed on Online/Mobile bill payments

assessment: Functional but dated; payee-type detection is implicit and the only bank-published tutorials are 2020-era demos now unplayable.

terms.fees: Scheduled/next-day free; Rush $2.00 (reimbursed for Beyond Checking)
